name: Mountebank Sidhe Trickster
body:
Mountebanks with blood ties to the fae courts deceive and make jokes for fun rather than for profit.

This is an archetype for the Mountebank class by Lost Spheres Publishing, using the Spheres system.

Faerie Training: A sidhe trickster gains the Fallen Fey sphere as a bonus magic talent and uses her class level as her caster level with the Fallen Fey sphere. This stacks normally with caster levels gained from other sources.

This ability replaces trickster training.

Fae Musician: A sidhe trickster must select Enchanting Music as the first talent they gain from this class.

This ability replaces natural scoundrel.

Sidhe Performance: The sidhe trickster gains Enchanting Performance as a bonus feat. She also gains the bardic performance ability as a bard of her same level, but only to the purpose of using Enchanting Performance. She cannot use any of the normal bardic performances unless she selects them using her quirks (see below).

This ability replaces thief ’s mark.

Lover Quirks: The sidhe trickster may select any quirk from the troubadour’s Lover persona in place of a social talent, using her mountebank level as her troubadour level for the purposes of these quirks. She can also select inspire courage as a performance to gain with a quirk.
